author: web-viz/designer
content: When building zero-dependency publication-grade visual architecture showcases: 1. Embed all SVGs inline rather than using external files or tags, allowing SVGs to inherit CSS custom properties (var(--bg-surface), var(--team-base), etc.) so diagrams dynamically update on theme toggles. 2. Structure the document with semantic sections matching the core architecture: Names & Acronyms, N-Layer Hive Topology, Pure Git-Native Storage Split (Dual-Zone), Visibility & Reactive Doorbells, and Lifecycle & Resource Conservation. 3. Validate HTML tag balance with html.parser and ensure zero external CDN/font/script dependencies for true offline portability.
title: Self-Contained Architecture Showcase & Dynamic SVG Styling
